text.p: NARODNA OBRODA - The Slovak parliament on Tuesday approved a resulution in which it recommends citizens to vote in favour of NATO membership in the forthcoming referendum on the question.
- Prime Minister Vladimir Meciar on Wednesday begins a two day official visit to France. Meciar is scheduled to meet his French counterpart Alain Juppe and President Jacques Chirac.
- Slovak-French trade turnover totalled 16.3 billion crowns, some five billion more than in 1995, with the Slovak deficit reaching 4.9 billion crowns.
- Germany's Deutsche Bank said it might open a branch in Slovakia, but that this would only make sense if German companies became more active in the country.

- A $100 million syndicated loan from Citibank to Slovak GSM operator Eurotel, signed last January, has an interest rate of only LIBOR plus 0.25 percent which is one of the best credit conditions ever given to a Slovak company.

HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Parliament on Tuesday included a proposal by the junior coalition party, the ultra-left Workers Party (ZRS), on a law stopping privatisation of all four of the largest state-controlled financial institutions. The draft law now goes to the second reading in the parliamentary committees.
PRAVDA - Engineering company SES Tlmace has formed a subsidiary SES Energo Caribe to help it retrieve its previous market position in Latin America.
SME - The parliament on Tuesday again failed to appoint members to a committee supervising activities of the state secret service, the SIS.
